To Identify barriers & facilitators to large-scale LHS implementation in interprofessional primary care teams, focusing on elderly patients (≥65 yrs) with ≥2 chronic conditions.

## 📊Expected Results

→Comparative insights into cross-country variations →Personalized scaling strategy for LHS in primary care →Co-developed roadmap for healthcare authorities covering regulatory, technological, organisational and patient engagement

dimensions

LIFT is the first multinational protocol to propose to systematically implement and evaluate LHS in primary care in continental Europe and Canada, addressing a critical gap for elderly patients with chronic conditions. Findings have the potential to inform policy and support health system transformation across 5 nations.
